synopsis: Wabtec’s first Level 9 validation with Komatsu took place in December 2021 on 730E and 860E haul trucks, covering speeds up to 30 km/h [f817]. Chapter 2 and the glossary report controlled deceleration at those speeds, while Chapter 2 also describes the case as using Level 9 slow-and-stop functionality [f1345, f15781, f1832, f1833]. Chapter 1 likewise identifies both truck models within Wabtec Collision Awareness System Level 9 coverage up to 30 km/h [f1073]. Physical testing still dominated integration, so this case is not evidence of predominantly virtual validation [f1347].
